subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do religions ignore social justice and human rights?
items.correct: No — many actively promote justice, charity and human dignity.
items.random_wrong: Only one religion cares about justice.
items.why: Concern for the poor and oppressed features strongly in many traditions.

items.q: Are human rights and religion always in conflict?
items.correct: No — many believers root human dignity and justice in their faith.
items.random_wrong: Religion has nothing to say about rights.
items.why: Faith motivates much human-rights and charitable work.

items.q: Do all religious teachings about wealth say the same thing?
items.correct: No — views differ, though many stress charity and responsibility.
items.misconception: Yes, all teach identical views on wealth.
items.why: Believers interpret teachings on money and giving in varied ways.
